reasoning_content: Now install `just`, `wasm-pack`, `bacon`, `sqlx-cli`. Also add wasm32 target. Let's install just first, then others in parallel? cargo install builds serially. Let's do them together in one cargo install command maybe. But that could be slow. Let's start with wasm32 target and just.

action.command: . /root/.cargo/env; rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown >/tmp/wasm-target.log 2>&1; echo "target exit=$?"; cargo install just >/tmp/just-install.log 2>&1; echo "just exit=$?"; tail -3 /tmp/just-install.log; /root/.cargo/bin/just --version
